newsitem.title: USA: Typhoon Violet weakening but still danger to ships.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Violet weakening but still danger to ships.

text.p: Typhoon Violet is expected to pass about 250 miles east of Okinawa, Japan, during the next 36 hours, on a track to the northeast, Weather Services Corp said.
Top winds, now near 105 mph, will weaken further to near 90 mph, but Violet will still remain a strong storm and a fairly significant threat to shipping.
The effects of the storm on Okinawa will be limited to rough surf, gusty winds from the northeast to north, and a few locally heavy rain squalls.
